description:
Perform an outlier analysis using linear regression on the 'Exam Anxiety' dataset. 

1. The dataset '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already loaded. 
2. Run a Linear Regression with 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable, and 'Revise' and 'Anxiety' as Covariates. 
3. IMPORTANT: In the 'Save' options of the analysis settings, enable 'Predicted values' and 'Residuals'. This will add two new columns to the spreadsheet. 
4. Go to the Data tab, examine the new 'Residuals' column, and identify the student (row) with the LARGEST POSITIVE residual (the student who overperformed the most). 
5. Save the Jamovi project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/Exam_Outlier_Analysis.omv'. 
6. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/outlier_student.txt' with the details of that student in the following format:
   Student_Code: <Code>
   Actual_Exam: <value>
   Predicted_Exam: <value>
   Residual: <value>
